title: Methods that use methods
summary: scaleJoystick calls clamp; isPalindrome calls reverseString.

steps.title: Don't repeat yourself
steps.say: `scaleJoystick` needs the same range check `clamp` already does, so it **calls** clamp instead of copying it.

steps.title: Build on what you have
steps.say: A palindrome reads the same backwards, so: does it equal its own reverse?

steps.title: Why it matters
steps.say: If the range check ever changes, you fix it in **one** place, and every caller gets the fix. That's the whole point of methods.
